svg.text: Only your own pieces vote. The King and the Candidate don't.
Each backs whichever is nearer in king-steps, the Candidate or
the King; a tie backs the King. Under each piece: steps to the
A piece the enemy attacks abstains (crossed out).

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Commons: pawns, 1 vote each. A tie goes to the King.
College: Knight 2, Bishop 2, Rook 3 (the badge on each piece).
The Queen is the Speaker: she votes only to break a College tie.

svg.text: The College alone crowns the d2 pawn; the opponent gains a Writ;
the e1 King becomes a Pretender pawn.
Position: c-populist-vs-monarchist-s18-g01-s18000, ply 25. The dashed line is the Speaker.
